name: Protein Muffins
instructions:
Brown Sugar
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees and line the muffin pan with liners.
Add ½ cup of brown sugar, 1 egg, and 2 tablespoons of melted and cooled butter to a bowl.
Add ¼ cup of applesauce, ¾ cup of protein milk, and ½ tablespoon cinnamon with salt.
Add 1.5 cups rolled oats and 1 teaspoon baking powder.
Use a ¼ cup measuring cup to pour into the pan.
Top with chocolate chips/flax seed and hemp hearts.
Bake for 30 minutes.

name: Protein Oats
instructions:
Combine 1 cup of protein oats, ½ cup of peanut butter, ½ cup flax seed, ½ cup chocolate chips, ⅓ cup honey, and 1 teaspoon vanilla extract.
Chill for 1-2 hours.
Roll then refrigerate.

name: Brown Butter Brownies

ingredients.name: (½ Cup) Packed Light Brown Sugar
ingredients.text: 100 grams (½ Cup) Packed Light Brown Sugar

ingredients.name: Chocolate Chips or Chopped Chocolate
ingredients.text: ¾ Cup Chocolate Chips or Chopped Chocolate

instructions:
Brown the Butter: Melt butter oven medium heat until it turns golden brown. Let cool for 5 minutes.
Whisk the granulated sugar + brown sugar into the warm butter. Add eggs and vanilla. Whisk vigorously for 1–2 minutes until thick, glossy, and slightly lighter in color.
Add dry ingredients: Sift in cocoa, flour, salt. Fold in chocolate chips.
Line an 8×8 pan with parchment. Spread in the batter. Bake at 350°F for 23–27 minutes.

name: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies

ingredients.name: (2 and ¼ Cup) All-Purpose Flour
ingredients.text: 280 g (2 and ¼ Cup) All-Purpose Flour

ingredients.name: (1 Cup) Packed Light Brown Sugar
ingredients.text: 200 g (1 Cup) Packed Light Brown Sugar

ingredients.name: (1.5 cups) semisweet or dark chocolate chips/chunks
ingredients.text: 255 g (1.5 cups) semisweet or dark chocolate chips/chunks

instructions:
Brown the Butter: Add the 226 grams of butter to a pan over medium heat until it browns. Let cook for 10-15 minutes until warm.
Whisk the Dry Ingredients: 280 grams flour, 1 tsp baking soda, ¾ tsp salt, and set aside.
Whisk the Wet Ingredients: stir together the brown butter, 200 grams light brown sugar, and 100 grams granulated sugar. Add both eggs and 1 tablespoon of vanilla. Mix until glossy and cohesive.
Dump in the dry ingredients, mix until just combined. Fold in the 255 grams of chocolate.
Roll into balls and place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Chill at least 30-60 minutes, preferably 2+ hours or overnight.
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Scoop 2-3 tbsp portions (around 50-60 grams). Bake 10-12 minutes until the edges are set and the centers still look soft and puffy. Sprinkle with flaky salt and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies Small Batch

ingredients.name: Plain Whole-Milk Greek Yogurt
ingredients.text: ½ Tablespoon Plain Whole-Milk Greek Yogurt

ingredients.name: A Whole Egg and ½ an Egg Yolk
ingredients.text: ½ A Whole Egg and ½ an Egg Yolk

ingredients.name: Milk or Dark Chocolate Chips or Chunks
ingredients.text: 68 Grams Milk or Dark Chocolate Chips or Chunks

instructions:
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Brown 113 grams salted butter. Let cool for 15 minutes until room temperature.
Beat together brown butter, 160 grams brown sugar, and 25 grams granulated sugar on low speed until well-combined.
Beat in the 1 tablespoon vanilla extract, ½ tablespoon greek yogurt, and ½ a whole egg and ½ an egg yolk for another minute.
In a separate bowl, whisk together 135 grams flour, ½ tsp baking soda, and ¼ tsp of kosher salt.
Slowly add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients. Add 68 grams of semisweet chocolate chips and 68 grams milk chocolate chips.
On a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, roll the dough into balls and let refrigerate for 30-40 minutes, or longer for more flavor.
Bake for 9-11 minutes then immediately sprinkle with flaky sea salt.
Let cool.

name: Brown Butter No Bake Cookies
instructions:
Brown the Butter: Melt the 2 and ⅔ Sticks Kerrygold Butter over medium heat until deep golden brown. Stir in 2 ⅔ Cups Granulated Sugar, ⅔ Cup Unsweetened Cooca Powder, and ½ Cup Heavy Cream.
Cook the Base: Return the pan to medium heat and stir until the mixture starts to boil. Let it boil for one minute without stirring.
Remove from heat. Stir in 2 Tsp Vanilla Extract, ⅔ Cup reamy Peanut Butter, and a pinch of salt until smooth. Add ⅔ cup chocolate chips while still warm. Stir in 5 ⅓ Cup Quick Oats until fully coated and glossy. If it looks too thick, add in extra cream.
Let cool for 2-3 minutes, then fold in the remaining ⅔ cup chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto a parchment-lined baking sheet. Let cool at room temperature.
Optional: Make a chocolate ganache by heating ¼ cup heavy cream until steaming. Pour over ½ cup chocolate chips, let sit for one minute and stir until smooth. Drizzle over cooked cookies and top with flaky salt.

name: Brown Butter Raspberry–Lemon Crumble Bars
instructions:
Add 226 grams of unsalted butter to a sauce pan. Let brown over medium heat and set aside to cool for 5-10 minutes.
In a bowl, mix together 250 g flour, ½ Tsp Baking Powder, and 1/2 Tsp Fine Salt.
In another large bowl, mix together the browned butter, 200 g Granulated Sugar, 50 g Light Brown Sugar, 1 tsp of vanilla extract, ½ tsp of almond extract, and lemon zest.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet until crumbs form. Set aside 1 heaping cup of this mixture. Press the rest firmly into a parchment-lined 8x8 pan.
In a bowl, toss together the 2.5 cups of raspberries, 70 g of granulated sugar, 2 tbsp lemon juice, and 2 tbsp cornstarch. Optionally, add another ½ tsp of vanilla and 1 tablespoon of raspberry jam. Spread evenly over the crust.
Scatter the reserved dough into big chunks and scatter them over the raspberry layer. Sprinkle a pinch of sea salt on top.
Bake at 350°F for 38–45 minutes, until the crumble is lightly golden and the raspberry filling is bubbling around the edges. Let cool completely before cutting. Top with a tiny dusting of powdered sugar or a homemade mascarpone whipped topping.
Place the mixing bowl and beaters in the freezer for 10 minutes. Keep the mascarpone and cream cold.
In a cold bowl, add 8 oz mascarpone, ⅓ cup powdered sugar, vanilla and almond extract. Beat on low until just smooth and creamy (about 15-20 seconds). With the mixer on low, slowly add in 1 cup of heavy cream.
Increase to medium-high and whip until thick, fluffy, soft peaks become firm peaks, usually around 45-60 seconds. Fold in lemon zest.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions:
Brown Sugar
Cream together ½ cup sugar, ½ cup butter, and 1 cup of brown sugar.
Add 1 room temperature egg and 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract, mix.
In a separate bowl, sift together 1 teaspoon of salt, 1.25 cups flour, ½ teaspoon of baking soda. Mix and add to wet ingredients.
Add 8 ounces of chocolate chips.
Chill for 2 hours.
Bake at 250 for 8-13 minutes.

name: Chocolate Covered Raspberries
instructions:
Mash raspberries and add to parchment paper.
Cover with a dollop of melted peanut butter.
Melt chocolate chips with a tablespoon of coconut oil.
Dip in chocolate and freeze until solid.

name: Cornbread with Honey Butter

ingredients.name: Sour cream or Extra Buttermilk
ingredients.text: ½ Cup Sour cream or Extra Buttermilk

instructions:
1.) Make the creamed corn: In a saucepan over medium heat, melt 2 tbsp of butter. Add 1 cup of corn and ½ cup whole milk, 1 teaspoon of sugar, and a pinch of salt. Let this simmer for 5 minutes. Blend until smooth with some texture. Add the remaining ½ cup of corn. Sprinkle in 1 tablespoon of flour for 2-3 minutes until thickened. Let cool slightly.
2.) Brown the butter: add ½ cup butter to a saucepan, Melt over medium heat until browned. Let cool for 5-10 minutes.
3.) Preheat the oven to 400°F, lightly grease a 13×9 baking dish (or line with parchment).
4.) Mix dry ingredients: Whisk together 2 cups cornmeal, 1 ½ cups flour, 1 tbsp baking powder, and 1 tsp salt.
5.) Mix wet ingredients: whisk together browned butter, ½ cup vegetable oil, ¾ cup sugar, 3 eggs, 1 cup milk or buttermilk, ½ cup sour cream or extra buttermilk, stir until smooth. Stir in creamed corn. Combine wet mixture into the dry. Fold until just combined.
6.) Pour batter into the pan. Bake for 20 minutes then glaze with 3 tbsp melted butter, 2 tbsp honey, pinch of salt. Return to the oven and bake for another 10-15 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Once out of the oven, top with the remaining 3 tbsp melted butter, 2 tablespoons of honey, and salt.
7.) To reheat: Preheat the oven to 300°F. Cover the pan with foil and warm for 12-18 minutes. Brush extra honey butter on the top.

name: Key Lime Pie Bites

ingredients.name: Graham Cracker Crumbs (10-12 full crackers)
ingredients.text: 1.5 Cup Graham Cracker Crumbs (10-12 full crackers)

instructions:
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Line a 12 muffin tin with liners.
Prep the crust by adding together the crushed graham crackers, melted butter, and sugar. Pack into the bottom of the muffin tins with a shot glass. Bake for 5 minutes to set them and let cool.
Whisk together the sweetened condensed milk, greek yogurt, key lime juice, and vanilla until smooth and creamy.
Spoon the filling over the crusts and bake for 10-12 minutes.
Let the crusts cool for 20-30 minutes and refrigerate.

name: Lemon Mascarpone Bars with Raspberry Coulis

ingredients.name: Sugar plus 3-4 Tablespoons for Coulis
ingredients.text: ¾ Cup Sugar plus 3-4 Tablespoons for Coulis

instructions:
Preheat the oven to 350.
Line the 9X9 baking pan with parchment paper.
To make the crust: combine 1 cup all-purpose flour, ¼ cup granulated sugar, ½ cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, Pinch of salt, and Zest of ½ lemon until a soft, crumbly dough forms.
Press evenly into the bottom of the pan.
Bake for 10–12 minutes, until lightly golden around the edges.
Set aside to cool slightly while you make the filling.
To make the filling, combine 1 cup of Marscapone, add 2 eggs, ½ cup granulated sugar, 1½ tbsp all-purpose flour, Zest of 1 lemon, Juice of 1 large lemon (~3 tbsp), ½ tsp vanilla extract, and 1 tbsp limoncello (for a boozy Italian twist). Whisk until smooth and combined.
Pour filling over the warm crust and smooth the top.
Bake for 20-24 minutes until the center is just barely set (a little jiggle is okay).
Cool completely at room temperature, then chill at least 2 hours before cutting.
Dust with powdered sugar before serving.
To make the raspberry coulis, add 1.5 cups raspberries, 3-4 tablespoons of granulated sugar, 1-2 teaspoons of lemon juice, 1-2 tablespoons of water as needed, and 1 teaspoon of limoncello to a pot.
Simmer over medium heat for 6-8 minutes until the berries break down.
Blend until smooth.
Use a fine mesh sieve to strain out as many seeds as possible.

name: Lemon Raspberry Bars

ingredients.name: fresh lemon juice (3–4 lemons)
ingredients.text: ⅔ cup fresh lemon juice (3–4 lemons)

ingredients.name: lemon zest (you can go heavier if you want it extra bright)
ingredients.text: 1 tbsp lemon zest (you can go heavier if you want it extra bright)

instructions:
Prep: Preheat oven to 350°F, line a 9x13 pan with parchment (leave overhang)
Brown the 226 grams butter, remove from heat and cool slightly.
Mix brown butter, 100 grams sugar, 2 tsp vanilla, and salt. Add 240 grams flour and mix until a soft dough forms.
Press dough evenly into the pan, bake for 24 minutes until golden brown.
Make filling: whisk 300 grams sugar, 30 grams of flour. Add 4 large eggs and whisk until smooth. Mix in ⅔ cup lemon juice and 1 tbsp lemon zest. Add ½ cup smashed raspberries and 3 tablespoons of raspberry jam.
Pour filling over the hot crust.
Combine ingredients for crumble: Add 60 grams flour, 50 grams sugar, pinch of salt, 4 tablespoons of melted butter, and ½ tsp vanilla.
Crumble it over the top. Bake for 30 minutes until the center is set and the top is lightly golden.
Cool at room temperature and chill 1-2 hours before cutting.

name: No Bake Cookies
instructions:
In a saucepan, melt 1 cup of sugar, ¼ cup of milk, 4 tablespoons of butter, and ⅛ cup of cocoa powder. Bring to a medium boil and boil for 1 minute.
Remove from heat and stir in 1/2 tablespoon of vanilla extract, 1.5 cups of oats, and ½ cup of peanut butter.
Scoop cookies onto a parchment lined cookie sheet and refrigerate.

name: Sweet Potato Casserole
instructions:
Roast the Potatoes: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Wash potatoes, peel off skins, and dice into ½ inch dice. Cook for 22-28 minutes, stirring halfway until they are easily pierced by a fork.
Brown Butter: Brown 6 tablespoons of butter until golden. Let cool slightly.
Make the Cinnamon Filling: Whisk together 6 tbsp of butter, 1 tbsp of cinnamon, 1 cup of flour, 1 cup packed brown sugar, ½ tsp of vanilla, and a pinch of nutmeg. This should resemble a thick, sandy streusel.
Make the Pecan Topping: Toast 1 cup of chopped pecans on a baking sheet at 350°F for 5–7 minutes until fragrant. After this, mix pecans with 2 tbsp of flour, 2 tbsp of brown sugar, ¼ cup melted butter, 1 tbsp maple syrup, ¼ tsp cinnamon, and a pinch of flaky salt. Set aside.
Sweet Potato Base: Mash roasted sweet potatoes with a ricer until smooth. Add ½ cup brown sugar, 2 large eggs, ½ cup room temp whole milk, ¼ cup browned butter, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 tbsp maple syrup, ¾ tsp kosher salt, 1 tsp cinnamon, and ¼ tsp nutmeg. Mix until smooth and silky.
Assemble the Casserole: Grease a 9x13 dish. Spread half of the sweet potato mixture into the dish. Crumble the cinnamon filling evenly over the top. Add the remaining half of the sweet potato mixture on top. Sprinkle the pecan mixture evenly over everything.
Bake at 350°F for 35–45 minutes, uncovered, until the center is hot and the topping is golden and crisp.
Optional: Add 1.5 cups mini marshmallows on top for the last 10 minutes of baking. Add a sprinkle of flaky salt on top.

ingredients.name: Red Kidney Beans, drain and rinsed, 1 can
ingredients.text: 14.5 ounces Red Kidney Beans, drain and rinsed, 1 can

ingredients.name: Black Beans, drain and rinsed, 1 can
ingredients.text: 14.5 ounces Black Beans, drain and rinsed, 1 can

ingredients.name: Fresh or Frozen Sweet Corn
ingredients.text: 1 Cup Fresh or Frozen Sweet Corn

ingredients.text: 1 Cup Mexican Shredded Cheese Blend, for garnishing

name: Lasagna Soup
instructions:
Saute 1 onion, add garlic, and Italian sausage until fully cooked.
Add tomato paste, 2 cups marinara sauce, 3 cups chicken broth, and ½ cup heavy cream.
Let boil and add ½ box lasagna noodles.
Top with spinach.
Top with ricotta, mixed with parmesan/mozzarella, parsley, and basil.

name: Lemon Chicken Orzo
instructions:
Saute three medium carrots, 3 celery stalks, and ½ onion in butter.
Add garlic and seasoning.
Add two tablespoons of flour and 6 cups of chicken broth.
Cover and let boil.
Add 1 cup of orzo and let cook uncovered for 8-10 minutes.
Add rotisserie chicken, lemon juice and lemon zest.

name: Loaded Potato Soup
instructions:
Dice up half an onion, and several celery stalks, and cube 4 potatoes.
Drop cubed potatoes in cold water. Slice 6 bacon strips.
Fry bacon, then use bacon fat to sear onion and celery.
Add garlic and season.
Add 5 tablespoons flour.
Add 2.5 cups of vegetable stock and vegetable bullion.
Let thicken, then add 2 cups of heavy cream.
Add potatoes and let boil for 12 minutes.
Top with fried bacon, cheddar cheese, and S&P.

name: Pasta Fagioli
instructions:
Saute carrots, celery, and onion until softened. Add in garlic and saute until fragrant.
Add the ground beef and saute until browned.
Stir in 2-3 tablespoons of tomato paste until caramelized.
Add 6 cups broth, marinara, beans, and bay leaf. Bring to a boil, let simmer on low for 30 minutes uncovered.
Add the ditalini and cook until al dente (8-10 minutes).
Towards the end of cooking, add in the chopped kale.

name: Tortellini Sausage Soup
instructions:
Seasonings: Bay leaf, Italian seasoning, onion powder or garlic powder.
In a large pot, heat oil over medium heat. Add onion, celery, carrot, and seasonings. Saute until tender.
Add in Italian sausage and cook until no longer pink.
Add in 3 tbsp of tomato paste and cook for about 2 minutes. Sprinkle in 3 tbsp flour and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Deglaze with ½ cup white wine. Let cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in 28 oz crushed tomatoes and 4 cups of chicken broth. Add in 1 bay leaf. Let simmer uncovered for 20-30 minutes.
Remove the bayleaf. Add 16 ounces cheese tortellini and let cook for 3-4 minutes. Pour in ½ cup half and half with 2 cups of spinach. Top with parmesan cheese.

name: Birria Tacos

ingredients.name: Ground Cumin, 1 Tbsp Dried Oregano, 1 Cinnamon Stick, 2 Bay Leaves
ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp Ground Cumin, 1 Tbsp Dried Oregano, 1 Cinnamon Stick, 2 Bay Leaves

instructions:
Pat beef dry and season thoroughly.
Sear in a cast iron pan on all sides until browned.
Add beef to Crockpot and top with bouillon and onion soup mix.
Brown one diced red onion and garlic, deglaze with Worcestershire sauce and add to Crockpot.
Toast 4 Guajillo chilis and add to Crockpot.
Add 1 can of Chipotle chilis in adobo, 1 tablespoon of tomato paste, 32 ounces of beef stock, 1 can of fire roasted tomatoes, ¼ cup apple cider vinegar, 1 tablespoon of ground cumin and dried oregano, 1 teaspoon of smoked paprika and ground coriander, 1 cinnamon stick, 3 bay leaves, ½ tablespoon of grated ginger.
Cook on low for 8 hours.
Remove bay leaves and cinnamon stick and blend together consomme.
Assemble birria tacos with diced onion, lime, and shredded cheese with consomme on the side.
Heat up oil in a large pot and sear chuck roast on all sides until browned.
Prep the sauce: Remove stems & seeds from chiles, simmer in hot water for 10-15 minutes, blend softened chilies with 1 medium onion, 8 cloves of garlic, ¼ cup vinegar, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp Mexican oregano, onion soup mix, and 4 cups of beef bone broth until smooth.
Pour sauce over meat. Top with bay leaves and cinnamon sticks. Cover and let braise for 3-3.5 hours.

name: Butter Chicken
instructions:
Paprika, Cayenne, Garam Masala, Cumin, Coriander.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a pan and add 2 sliced onions. Saute until caramelized.
Add two tablespoons of tomato paste, 2 tablespoons of grated ginger, and garlic.
Add 2 tablespoons of paprika and garam masala, one teaspoon of cayenne, cumin, coriander, and a dash of salt and pepper and combine.
Deglaze the pan with 1 can of fire roasted tomatoes and ½ cup water.
Add sauce to blender and blend until smooth.
Combine 2 pounds diced chicken and sauce.
Cook on low for 3-4 hours or on high for 2-3 hours.
Finish with slices of butter and 1 cup of nonfat plain greek yogurt.
Serve over rice.

name: Carnitas

ingredients.name: Seasonings: seasoning packet, cayenne pepper, chili powder, cumin, dried cilantro,
ingredients.text: Seasonings: seasoning packet, cayenne pepper, chili powder, cumin, dried cilantro,

instructions:
Add 1 medium sliced onion.
Put 4 pound marinated pork in the crockpot on top of the onions.
Season pork with seasoning packet, S&P, and garlic powder. Add garlic.
Add ½ cup chicken broth and juice of 1 lime.
Cook on low for 7-8 hours.
Shred and serve with tortillas and cheese.

name: Chicken Piccata
instructions:
Pour ½ cup of flour into a bag, lightly coat 2 pounds of chicken tenderloins with seasoned flour.
Heat olive oil on the skillet and brown the cutlets on each side.
Place chicken in the Crockpot.
Add 2 tablespoons of butter to the skillet and scrape the browned bits. Add 2 tablespoons of unused flour and cook off for 1-2 minutes.
Brown garlic.
Add 1.5 cups of chicken broth to the roux and let simmer.
Add 4 tablespoons of lemon juice and lime zest.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions:
Add chicken, seasonings, onion, 2 cream of chicken soup cans, and mixed vegetables.
Cook on low for 4-6 hours.
Stir in ½ cup half/half.
Serve with biscuits.

name: Chicken and Dumplings
instructions:
Add chicken to crock pot, and season.
Add diced onion, celery, and carrots with cream of chicken soup, cream of onion soup, and 3 cups of chicken broth.
Cook on high for 4 hours.
Shred chicken and serve with biscuits.

name: Creamy Chicken Pasta
instructions:
Short Rib Pasta: Serves 7 people with leftovers
Throw a pound of chicken breasts in the crockpot and season, add fresh garlic.
Add a jar of marinara and alfredo.
Cook on low for 4-6 hours.
Dice the chicken, add back to the sauce, add cheese.
Add protein pasta and serve with additional cheese.

name: Creamy Lemon Chicken
instructions:
In a pan, add one tablespoon of butter.
Season the chicken and brown on both sides.
Put the chicken in the crockpot with the juice and zest of two lemons, garlic, and 5 tablespoons of butter in slices. Deglaze the pan with chicken stock or water.
Cook on low for 4 hours or on high for 2 hours.
Combine together 1 cup of half and half with one tablespoon of cornstarch, and one tablespoon of chicken base. Add to the crockpot.
Cook on high for an additional hour.

name: Crockpot Chicken Alfredo
instructions:
Add chicken, 2 cups heavy cream, 1.5 cups chicken broth, 4 ounces cream cheese, and 4 tablespoons of butter to crockpot with seasonings. Cook on high for 2 hours.
Shred chicken then add in pasta and 1/2 parmesan for 30 minutes on high until pasta is tender.

ingredients.name: Fresh Thyme or Rosemary, 1 Bay Leaf
ingredients.text: Fresh Thyme or Rosemary, 1 Bay Leaf

name: Teriyaki Chicken
instructions:
Brown Sugar
Place the chicken in the slow cooker.
In a bowl, whisk together 2 teaspoons of garlic and ginger, ¼ cup of honey, 3 tablespoons of brown sugar, ½ cup of soy sauce, 2 teaspoons of toasted sesame oil, and 2 tablespoons of rice vinegar. Pour over the chicken.
Cook on low for 6-7 hours or high for 3-4 hours.
If needed, combine 2 tablespoons of cornstarch with ¼ cup of cold water and add to sauce in a pan. Let the sauce come to a boil and let it thicken.

ingredients.name: Bagged Rice or Airfried Tortilla Chips
ingredients.text: Bagged Rice or Airfried Tortilla Chips

name: Asian-Style Beef Burgers
instructions:
Combine ½ ounce of dried mushrooms with 1 cup of hot water to rehydrate for 10 minutes.
Dice 1 pound of broccoli and dice 6 ounces of carrots.
Slice 2 scallions, separating white bottoms and green tops.
Discard the root of the 10 ounces of bok choy, thinly slicing the leaves and stems crosswise. Add olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Heat one tablespoon of sesame oil, add carrots and broccoli, and stir for 6-8 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Add ½ cup of water until vegetables are softened. Add 1 tablespoon of apple cider vinegar for 1-2 minutes and set aside in a bowl.
Finely chop drained rehydrated mushrooms, and add 1.5 pounds of beef, with white bottoms of scallions, 2 tablespoons of hoisin sauce, and garlic. Season with salt and pepper.
Form the mixture into 4 patties and add to a pan with olive oil.
Sear for 4-5 minutes per side.
Toast the buns with additional olive oil if needed until browned.
Add cooked patties and seasoned bok choy, with cooked vegetables on the side. Garnish vegetables with green tops of the scallions.

name: Baked Mac n Cheese
instructions:
Seasonings: ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp onion powder, ¼–½ tsp smoked paprika, 1–2 tsp Dijon mustard, salt and pepper.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 9×13-inch baking dish.
Cook the pasta.
Saute the onions until soft and lightly golden.
Make the cream base: Add the butter, whole milk, and heavy cream with the onions. Warm gently until the butter melts. Add 4 ounces of cream cheese. Stir until the cream cheese is fully melted.
Reduce heat to low and add ⅔ of each cheese. Stir slowly until melted and creamy. Season the sauce.
Combine the pasta and sauce, layer the pan with remaining cheese and pasta. Top with the rest.
Bake uncovered for 25–30 minutes, until bubbling around the edges and lightly golden on top.
To reheat: Add a splash of milk.

name: Barbecue Chicken Bake
instructions:
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Pat chicken dry.
Season with onion powder, garlic powder, all purpose seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Sear in melted butter until golden brown on both sides.
Place in a greased baking dish, layer with barbecue sauce and cheddar cheese on top.
Bake for 30 minutes or until the chicken is 165 degrees.
While the chicken is baking, cook bacon on the stove.
Once chicken is cooked, serve with more sauce, cheese, and bacon on top.

ingredients.name: Ground Cumin, 1 Tbsp Dried Oregano, 1 Cinnamon Stick, 2 Bay Leaves
ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp Ground Cumin, 1 Tbsp Dried Oregano, 1 Cinnamon Stick, 2 Bay Leaves

name: Beef Bolognese (Macro Friendly)

ingredients.name: 93% Lean Ground Beef or Turkey
ingredients.text: 2.5  lb 93% Lean Ground Beef or Turkey

ingredients.name: Seasonings: 2 tsp Italian Seasoning, Oregano, 2 Bay Leaves, Salt and Pepper, Red Pepper Flakes, 1 Tsp Worcestershire Sauce
ingredients.text: Seasonings: 2 tsp Italian Seasoning, Oregano, 2 Bay Leaves, Salt and Pepper, Red Pepper Flakes, 1 Tsp Worcestershire Sauce

instructions:
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium. Add onion, carrot, celery. Cook for 10-12 minutes until soft and golden.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Stir in tomato paste and let cook for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add ground beef and cook until no pink remains.
Pour in red wine, scrap the pot well. Simmer 5-7 minutes until reduced by half.
Add crushed tomatoes, broth, bay leaves, herbs, seasonings, and Worcestshire sauce.
Simmer for 45-75 minutes, partially uncovered, stirring occasionally. Add broth as needed.
To finish, remove bay leaves.

name: Beef Stir Fry

ingredients.name: lbs Top Sirloin for Stir Fry
ingredients.text: 1.5 lbs Top Sirloin for Stir Fry

instructions:
Tenderize and Marinate Beef: Mix together beef, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp cornstarch, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 tbsp avocado oil, and seasonings. Let sit for 15-20 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together: seasoning packet, ¼ cup soy sauce, 2 tbsp hoisin, 1 tbsp chili crisp, 1 tbsp ginger paste, 2 tbsp beef broth, 1 tsp honey and 1 tsp cornstarch. Set aside.
Pan or Wok: Heat 1 tbsp oil on high heat. Cook beef in batches, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
Add sliced onion and cook for 2 minutes, then bell peppers for 3-4 minutes, add broccoli and snap peas for 3-4 more minutes, add beef back to the pan.
Pour sauce over the meat and veggies. Cook for 2-4 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Serve with rice or noodles.

name: Beef and Broccoli
instructions:
Brown meat and season with ginger, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Add in coleslaw mix and sauce packet.
Cook rice ramen.
Mix together and serve with broccoli.

name: Breaded Chicken
instructions:
Season chicken tenderloins with onion powder, garlic powder, all purpose seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Dunk chicken in seasoned flour.
Place in seasoned bread crumbs with half Panko, half italian breadcrumbs, and parmesan cheese.
Place in pan and shallow fry for 3-4 minutes per side until chicken is golden brown and fully cooked.

name: Cheeseburger Sliders w/ Mac n Cheese (Cooking in the Midwest)
Creamy Sausage Bowtie Pasta
instructions:
Add Parmesan Cheese/ Mozzarella
Brown 1 pound Italian sausage, and add garlic.
Cook bowtie pasta in a separate pot.
Sprinkle with a tablespoon of flour.
Pour in 1 pint of heavy cream and 1 cup chicken broth.
Add 1 bag of baby spinach.
Add parmesan cheese/ mozzarella.
Add drained bowtie pasta to the sauce.

name: French Onion Chicken
instructions:
Let olive oil get hot in a nonstick skillet.
Sear chicken breasts on both sides/season.
Set chicken aside and saute onions for 15 minutes, scrape the bottom of the skillet.
Once onions are cooked, put in one packet of soup mix and one can of soup.
Once boiling, put the chicken back into the skillet and cover for 10 minutes.
Top with cheese.

name: French Onion Pasta
instructions:
Melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat.
Add thinly sliced onions to the pot. Season with salt. Stir and cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Remove lid, turn heat to medium-low, and cook until onions are very caramelized.
Add thyme and roasted garlic, and saute for another minute.
Pour in just over a ¼ cup of white wine to deglaze the pot.
Add pasta, then pour in 3 cups of beef broth and 1 teaspoon of Worcestershire sauce. Bring to a boil and cook for about 15 minutes.
Stir in gruyere and ¼ cup half and half.

name: Homemade Chipotle Bowls

ingredients.name: Bagged Rice or Airfried Tortilla Chips
ingredients.text: Bagged Rice or Airfried Tortilla Chips

instructions: Build the bowls with barbacoa, queso, fajita vegetables, and either rice or airfried tortilla chips.

name: Honey Chipotle Chicken
instructions:
In a medium bowl, mash the garlic, Chipotle in adobo, smoked paprika, cumin, oregano, salt, and pepper with the back of a spoon to form a paste.
Whisk in the avocado oil, red wine vinegar, and honey until smooth and emulsified. Reserve 2 tbsp of the marinade in a small container, and refrigerate it.
Place the chicken into a container, and pour the remaining marinade over the top. Make sure the chicken is coated, then cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 24 hours.
Preheat the grill to maintain a temperature around 400ºF. Remove the chicken and the reserved marinade from the fridge. When the grill is preheated, lightly coat it with oil and lay the chicken thighs onto the grill.
Grill for 5-6 minutes or until the chicken easily loosens from the grill. Flip the chicken thighs and grill for another 4-6 minutes, or until the chicken is done.
Remove the chicken from the grill, carefully chop it into bite-sized pieces, and toss it with the reserved chipotle honey marinade. Serve immediately.
Blend together 3 chipotle peppers, 3 garlic cloves. 1 teaspoon of oregano and cumin, juice of one lime, and ¼ cup neutral oil.
Dice the chicken into small cubes.
Make the sauce with 2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, ¼ cup of honey, and the juice of 1 lime.
Put honey chipotle chicken in the air fryer at 375 for 18-22 minutes. Cover with sauce after cooking.

name: Italian-Style Meatballs

ingredients.name: 28 Ounce Cans Whole peeled San Marzano tomatoes
ingredients.text: 2 28 Ounce Cans Whole peeled San Marzano tomatoes

ingredients.name: Seasonings: Salt and Pepper, 1 Tsp Crushed Red Pepper Flakes, 1 Tsp Dried Oregano, ½ Tsp Dried Thyme, Fresh Basil, 2 Bay Leaves
ingredients.text: Seasonings: Salt and Pepper, 1 Tsp Crushed Red Pepper Flakes, 1 Tsp Dried Oregano, ½ Tsp Dried Thyme, Fresh Basil, 2 Bay Leaves

instructions:
Preheat the oven to 400.
In a large bowl, combine breadcrumbs and milk; let soak for 5 minutes.
Add sausage, ground beef, eggs, cheese, garlic, parsley, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Mix gently with hands until just combined — don’t overmix.
Roll into meatballs about 1.5–2 inches wide. Place meatballs on an oiled baking sheet lined in aluminum foil.
Bake in oven for 18-20 minutes, flipping halfway.
Bake until internal temperature reaches 160.
Pat the chuck roast dry with paper towels. Season it liberally with salt, pepper, and a bit of Kinder’s seasoning on both sides.
Heat the olive oil in your Dutch oven over medium-high heat.Once hot, sear the roast 3–4 minutes per side until deep brown. Remove and set aside on a plate.
In the same pot, add onions and cook for 2–3 minutes, scraping up browned bits.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
If using tomato paste, stir it in here and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in 2 tbsp Worcestershire and about 1/2 cup of white or red wine to loosen up the fond (brown bits on bottom). Scrape the bottom with a wooden spoon.
Return the roast to the pot. Add carrots, celery, thyme/rosemary, and a bay leaf.
Pour the remaining bone broth until it comes halfway up the sides of the meat. Add the remaining seasoning over the top.
Transfer to the oven and roast for 3.5-4 hours.
To finish: remove the roast and vegetables to a platter. Use a sieve and strain the braising liquid. Heat a pot over medium, add 2-3 tablespoons of butter and 2-3 tablespoons of flour. Cook for 2-3 minutes until golden brown. Slowly whisk in the drippings. Let it bubble for 3-5 minutes, add extra stock if needed to thin it out.
Heat olive oil over medium-low in your Dutch oven. Add onions with a pinch of salt and cook slowly (~8 min) until translucent and sweet. Add sliced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant (don’t brown).
Stir in tomato paste; cook for 2–3 minutes until it darkens slightly.
Pour in white wine to deglaze, scraping up the fond from the bottom. Let it reduce by half (~3 min).
Crush San Marzano tomatoes by hand as you add them (or use a spoon). Add seasonings and stir to combine.
Bring to a gentle bubble, then reduce to very low heat. Cover partially and let simmer for 3–6 hours, stirring every 30–45 minutes.
If it thickens too much, add ¼ cup water or broth at a time. The sauce should be rich and glossy, not watery.
To finish: remove bay leaves, blend for a smooth texture. Stir in 2 Tbsp of butter and fresh basil right before serving.

name: Korean Beef Bowls

ingredients.name: reduced sodium soy sauce
ingredients.text: ¼ cup reduced sodium soy sauce

ingredients.name: crushed red-pepper flakes, or more to taste
ingredients.text: ½ teaspoon crushed red-pepper flakes, or more to taste

instructions:
In a small bowl, whisk together brown sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, red pepper flakes and ginger.
Heat vegetable oil in a large cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Add garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add ground beef and cook until browned, about 3-5 minutes, making sure to crumble the beef as it cooks; drain excess fat.
Stir in soy sauce mixture and green onions until well combined, allowing to simmer until heated through, about 2 minutes.
Serve immediately, garnished with green onion and sesame seeds, if desired.
Heat a large skillet over medium high heat. Add 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
In a large bowl, mix the ingredients for meatballs together, being careful not to overmix (overmixing causes tough meatballs).
Add the meatballs to the skillet, and cook on all sides, being careful not to overcrowd the pan.
When the meatballs are cooked through and browned on all sides, remove to a plate.
Cook the udon noodles according to package directions. Drain, rinse with cold water, and set aside.
Add the carrots, mushrooms, snow peas and cabbage to the skillet. Sautee the vegetables, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes, or until slightly softened.
In a glass, whisk together the ingredients for the sauce.
Pour the sauce over the vegetables.
Add in the meatballs and the noodles and toss to coat.
Cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally, until everything is heated through.
Serve, garnishing with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.
Melt 1 tablespoon Butter or Ghee (add avocado oil if using) in a large stockpot over medium-high heat.
Add 1 Medium Onion (diced), 2 Celery Stalks (sliced), 1 Medium Carrot (thinly sliced), 1 Large Red Bell Pepper (diced), 2-3 Garlic Cloves (chopped), and cook until softens. About 5-6 minutes.
Stir in seasonings ( 1½ teaspoon Ground Cumin, 1 tablespoon Chili Powder, and 1 teaspoon Dried Oregano, 15 ounces Diced fire-roasted Tomatoes, ¼ Cup Tomato Paste, and 4 Cups Low Sodium Chicken Broth. Season with Salt and pepper, to your taste, and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and simmer for about 10-15 minutes or until veggies are very tender.
Remove from heat and using a hand blender, blend the soup until smooth and creamy. Place the soup back over medium heat and add in 14.5 ounces Red Kidney Beans and 14.5 ounces Black Beans, 1 Cup Fresh or Frozen Sweet Corn, and 2 Cups Shredded Cooked Chicken.
Stir to combine and boil for a couple of minutes, just to heat it all.
Add chopped onion, garlic, jalapeno, and saute in oil until veggies soften.
Add chicken breasts, corn, beans, chili powder, cumin, crushed tomatoes, and chicken broth. Bring to a boil and let simmer.
Serve the soup with lime and cheese on top.

name: Lasagna

ingredients.name: Olive Oil and 2 Tbsp Kerrigold Butter
ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp Olive Oil and 2 Tbsp Kerrigold Butter

ingredients.name: Seasonings: Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Nature’s Seasoning, Salt and Pepper
ingredients.text: Seasonings: Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Nature’s Seasoning, Salt and Pepper

ingredients.name: Half Pound Ground Beef, Half Pound Italian Sausage
ingredients.text: Half Pound Ground Beef, Half Pound Italian Sausage

ingredients.name: Bouquet Garni with Thyme and Fresh Bay Leaves
ingredients.text: Bouquet Garni with Thyme and Fresh Bay Leaves

ingredients.name: Finely Grated Parmigiano Reggiano
ingredients.text: ½ Cup Finely Grated Parmigiano Reggiano

ingredients.name: In a bowl, crack two eggs and separate 2 egg yolks (4 eggs total)
ingredients.text: In a bowl, crack two eggs and separate 2 egg yolks (4 eggs total)

instructions:
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil and 2 tablespoons of Kerrigold butter. Add onion, carrot, and celery with salt. Let cook for 15-20 minutes on medium low until soft but not browned.
Add minced garlic and garlic powder, onion powder, and salt/pepper. Let cook until garlic is fragrant.
Add beef and Italian Sausage. Increase heat to medium and cook until no longer pink.
Pour in 1 cup dry red wine. Let simmer until almost completely reduced (about 5 minutes).
Stir in 1 tablespoon of tomato paste and 1 cup of whole milk. Let simmer until milk is absorbed (10-15 minutes). Then add 1.5 cups of crushed tomatoes, Parmesan rind, and a pinch of salt. Add a bouquet garni with 1 bay leaf and 2-3 thyme sprigs.
Reduce heat to very low and partially cover, let cook for 1.5-2 hours stirring occasionally.
Finish with 1–2 tbsp butter.
Weight out 240 grams of 00 Flour and make a well in the center.
Add eggs and salt. Whisk with fork until dry and shaggy.
Knead for 8-10 minutes until smooth and the dough springs back when pushed.
Wrap tightly with saran wrap and let rest for 30 minutes.
Cut into 4 equal pieces.
Lightly flour the dough pieces, flatten dough with your hands until 0.5 inch thick.
Set the pasta machine to the widest setting.
Feed dough through. Fold in thirds like a letter, then feed this through again. Repeat this 2-3 times.
Roll once, reduce setting, reduce again. Stop at setting 6 or 7. It should be thin enough to see through, but strong enough to lift. Cut each ¼ of dough into 4 equal sized pieces.
If they need to sit out, lightly cover with flour and cover with parchment paper.
1. ) Melt 5 tbsp of butter over medium heat. Whisk in 5 tbsp of all-purpose flour and cook for 2 minutes.
2.) Slowly whisk in 4 cups of warmed whole milk.
3.) Simmer gently until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon.
4.) Season with salt, pepper, nutmeg, and ½ cup of finely grated Parmigiano-Reggiano.
In a 9x13 pan, grease the pan with a little bit of butter.
Add a thin layer of bechamel.
Place a layer of fresh pasta sheets (3 in a layer)
Place a layer of bolognese (1 cup)
Place a drizzle of bechamel (¾ cup) and a dusting of parmesan.
Repeat this process 4-5 times.
Finish with pasta, bechamel and Parmesan on top.
Cover with foil and base at 375 for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake 15-20 minutes more until bubbling.
Let rest for 15 minutes prior to serving. Finish with flaky sea salt and microplaned Parmesan.

name: Meatloaf
instructions:
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees.
Soak breadcrumbs in milk for a few minutes.
Combine ground beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, parmesan, onion, garlic, tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and seasonings. Mix gently until just combined.
Form into a loaf on a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 45-55 minutes.
Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

name: Ricotta Meatballs
instructions:
Combine 15 ounces of ricotta cheese with 1 teaspoon of minced garlic and seasoning.
Heat olive oil in a pan, add 1 finely diced onion. Add garlic, season, and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine 1 egg, ½ cup half and half, ½ cup Italian breadcrumbs, ½ cup parmesan cheese, chopped parsley, ¾ cup ricotta mixture, seasoning, and sauteed onions with garlic.
Season the meat and add 1 pound ground chuck and ½ pound ground italian sausage.
Roll into 1.5 inch meatballs and refrigerate for 15 minutes (use oil on hands to make it easier).
Brown the meatballs in olive oil on all sides for 1.5 minutes per side.
Add 32 ounces of pasta sauce and a ¼ cup of water.
Add the meatballs and allow them to cook partially covered for 30 minutes.
During the last 15 minutes, scoop in spoonfuls of the remaining ricotta mixture.
Serve with pasta.

name: Rigatoni P
instructions:
Stir Fry Meat
Preheat the oven to 450 degrees.
On a foil-lined baking sheet, add 1 package of sliced mushrooms, 1 onion, minced garlic, ¼ cup balsamic vinegar, and minced garlic.
Whisk together 1.5 tablespoons of cornstarch and 2 cups of chicken broth.
Prepare pasta until slightly undercooked and place in a baking dish.
Mix 3 tablespoons of butter with a drizzle of olive oil, add seasoned chicken breasts and sear 3-4 minutes per side. Dice into chunks.
Add ½ cup white wine until liquid evaporates.
Add ¾ marsala wine until liquid reduces by half.
Whisk in chicken broth mixture and mix to combine.
Add 2 cups of heavy cream, salt and pepper, along with reserved mushrooms and cook for 6-8 minutes until thickened.
Add sauce to pasta.
Stir in parmesan cheese and chopped parsley and bake until brown on top.
Serve with garlic bread.
Combine ½ cup soy sauce ,½ cup vegetable stock, 1 teaspoon of sesame oil, ½ tablespoon of rice vinegar, 2 cloves of garlic, 1-2 teaspoons of grated ginger, 1 tablespoon of sugar, 1 tablespoon of cornstarch, and red pepper flakes.
Stir all of these ingredients thoroughly and set aside.
Heat a large skillet with 2 tablespoons of oil and add 1 pound of stir fry meat until fully cooked and set aside.
Add some butter and add diced onions to cook down, then add snap peas and peppers, cook for 5-7 minutes.
Add the protein back in with the vegetables, add stir fry sauce and allow to simmer covered for several minutes.
Serve with a choice of noodles or rice.

name: Sausage and Peppers
instructions:
Add olive oil to the pan and let it heat up.
Sear sausage on all sides for 5-7 minutes, slice and set aside.
Add butter to the pan and saute onions.
Once the onions have cooked down for 5-6 minutes, add garlic.
Once garlic is browned, add peppers and season.
Serve with pasta.

name: Soupy Chicken
instructions:
Brown 2 sliced onions in butter.
Pat dry chicken breasts.
Pour oil on top of the chicken.
Season the chicken with garlic powder, onion powder, all purpose seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Add seasoned chicken and sear on one side for 5 minutes, flip and sear again until slightly undercooked.
Add 2 cans of cream of chicken soup and milk.
Let combine until the chicken is 165 degrees in the center.
Serve with mashed potatoes and green beans.

name: Focaccia Bread
instructions:
Prepare dough according to the directions.
Brush 2-3 tablespoons of olive oil on a 9x13 pan.
Place dough in the pan.
Drizzle 2 tablespoons of olive oil mixed with 1-2 garlic cloves and rosemary salt.
Once out of the oven, top with flaky salt and extra garlic-infused olive oil.

name: Garlic Bread
instructions:
Roast garlic ahead of time.
Make the garlic butter by mixing together the mashed roasted garlic, softened butter, olive oil, and salt pepper. Top the bread with parmesan.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees, bake for 10-12 minutes and broil for 1-2 minutes.

name: Green Beans
instructions:
Boil water and add salt.
Let boil for 4-5 minutes until tender.
Drain and rinse with cold water to stop cooking.
Spray with oil and top with garlic powder and onion powder.

name: Parmesan-Crusted Oven Roasted Potatoes
instructions:
Melt ¼ cup butter, add ¼ cup olive oil, 1 tablespoon garlic, 2 tablespoons parsley, 3 tablespoons parmesan, red pepper flakes, and S&P.
Wash and slice 2 pounds of baby gold potatoes in half and toss in the mixture.
Transfer to a tray, and dip the flat side of the potato in parmesan.
Lay parmesan-crusted side down, and roast at 400 degrees until brown (30-40 minutes).

name: Parmesan-Crusted Roasted Potatoes
instructions:
Melt ¼ cup butter, add ¼ cup olive oil, 1 tablespoon garlic, 2 tablespoons parsley, 3 tablespoons parmesan, red pepper flakes, S&P.
Wash and slice 2 pounds of baby gold potatoes in half and toss in the mixture.
Transfer to a tray, and dip the flat side of the potato in parmesan.
Lay parmesan-crusted side down, and roast at 400 degrees until brown (30-40 minutes).

name: Parmesan-Garlic Butter Pizza Rolls
instructions:
Fry pizza rolls.
Add garlic butter.
Top with parmesan cheese.
Dip in marinara sauce.

name: Potatoes Au Gratin

ingredients.name: lbs Russet or Yukon Gold Potatoes
ingredients.text: 3 lbs Russet or Yukon Gold Potatoes

ingredients.name: Whole Milk (or 1¾ cups milk + ¼ cup heavy cream for extra richness)
ingredients.text: 2 Cups Whole Milk (or 1¾ cups milk + ¼ cup heavy cream for extra richness)

ingredients.name: Seasonings: 1 tsp salt, ½ black pepper
ingredients.text: Seasonings: 1 tsp salt, ½ black pepper

ingredients.name: freshly grated Parmesan (for the top — perfect amount)
ingredients.text: ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan (for the top — perfect amount)

instructions:
Roast the garlic: Preheat the oven to 400°, slice off the top of the garlic heads and drizzle with oil, roast 40-45 minutes until soft then squeeze cloves out.
Melt 3 tbsp butter of medium heat, whisk in 3 tbsp of flour and cook for 1 minute. Slowly whisk in the milk. Cook 3-5 minutes until thickened. Add the roasted garlic and blend to incorporate into the sauce. Add seasonings.
Stir in Gouda, Gruyère, and Havarti until smooth and melty.
Assemble: Grease a 9×13 baking dish with 2 tbsp butter. Later half the potatoes in the dish. Pour half of the cheese sauce. Add remaining potatoes, pour remaining cheese sauce over them. Sprinkle with ½ cup of parmesan.
Cover tightly with foil, bake at 375°F for 45 minutes. Remove foil and bake an additional 25-30 minutes until the top is golden and the potatoes are soft. Let rest 10–15 minutes before serving so it sets.

name: Roasted Garlic
instructions:
Preheat the oven to 400.
Peel away papery ends of whole garlic, but leave skins surrounding individual garlic cloves.
Slice ½ inch from the top, exposing the cloves.
Drizzle with olive oil, salt and pepper.
Cover with aluminum foil and place on a baking sheet for 30-40 minutes.

name: Roasted Garlic Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.name: lbs Yukon gold or Russet potatoes
ingredients.text: 3 lbs Yukon gold or Russet potatoes

instructions:
Roast the garlic: Preheat the oven to 400°, slice off the top of the garlic head and drizzle with oil, roast 40-45 minutes until soft then squeeze cloves out.
Cook the potatoes: Peel and dice, add potatoes to a large pot and cover with cold water. Add salt and bring to a boil. Let simmer for 15-18 minutes until fork tender. Use a ricer to mash the potatoes.
In a small saucepan, heat ½ heavy cream, 4 tablespoons of butter, and the thyme sprigs. Add your roasted garlic cloves. Remove herbs and blend to create a smooth garlic-infused cream.
Combine the cream with the potatoes until smooth.

name: Scalloped Potatoes

ingredients.name: lbs Yukon gold potatoes, peeled & sliced 1/8 inch thin
ingredients.text: 3 lbs Yukon gold potatoes, peeled & sliced 1/8 inch thin

ingredients.name: Seasonings: 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper, ½ tsp smoked paprika, Pinch nutmeg, ½ tsp onion powder, ¼ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp Dijon mustard
ingredients.text: Seasonings: 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper, ½ tsp smoked paprika, Pinch nutmeg, ½ tsp onion powder, ¼ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp Dijon mustard

instructions:
Preheat the oven to 375.
Peel and slice 3 lbs Yukon gold potatoes using a mandolin (1/8 inch thick).
In a pan, melt 3 tbsp butter on medium heat, add 3 cloves minced garlic and cook for 30-60 seconds, sprinkle in 3 tbsp of flour, stirring constantly for 1 minute. Slowly whisk in 2 cups of whole milk and 1 cup heavy cream. Let simmer for 3-5 minutes until thickened.
Reduce heat to low and add 4 ounces of cream cheese, whisk until smooth.
Add some of the shredded cheeses, leaving the remainder for the top and season. Stir until smooth and combined.
Add potatoes to the sauce and fold until every slice is coated.
Lightly grease the 9x13 dish. Add the potatoes and sauce in layers, using the shredded cheese in between.
Cover tightly with foil.
Bake at 375 for 45 minutes.
Remove foil and bake for another 30 minutes.
Broil for 2-3 minutes for a golden top.

name: Sweet-and-Spicy Maple Hot Honey Brussels Sprouts

ingredients.name: Lbs Brussels Sprouts, trimmed and halved
ingredients.text: 2 Lbs Brussels Sprouts, trimmed and halved

ingredients.name: Thick-Cut Bacon, cooked and chopped
ingredients.text: 3 Slices Thick-Cut Bacon, cooked and chopped

ingredients.name: Hot Honey and 1 Tsp Maple Syrup to drizzle
ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp Hot Honey and 1 Tsp Maple Syrup to drizzle

instructions:
Preheat the oven to 425 °F (220 °C). Line a large sheet pan with parchment paper.
Toss Brussels sprouts with olive oil, salt, pepper, and paprika. Spread cut-side down in a single layer.
Roast 20–25 minutes, flipping once, until edges are deeply golden and crisp.
Make the glaze: In a small saucepan, combine maple syrup, hot honey, Dijon, vinegar, soy sauce, and garlic. Warm 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Glaze: Toss roasted sprouts with the warm glaze to coat evenly.
Roast for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Finish: Add chopped bacon and toasted pecans, toss gently, then drizzle with the extra hot-honey/maple mix and a sprinkle of flaky salt right before serving.

name: Homemade Ranch Dip
instructions:
Combine: Whisk together the sour cream, mayo, and buttermilk until smooth.
Add seasoning. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, ideally overnight.
Stir well before serving.

name: Lasagna Dip (with Italian Sausage)
instructions:
1 Tsp Italian Seasoning, ½ tsp salt, ¼ tsp black pepper.
Roast the Garlic: Preheat the oven to 400°F, wrap tightly in foil and roast 40-45 minutes until soft. Squeeze out once cool. Add a spoonful of ricotta and blend until creamy.
Make the Base: Add ricotta, cream cheese, parmesan, mozzarella, egg, roasted garlic, and seasonings to a bowl. Use a hand mixer and beat until smooth.
Assemble: Spread the ricotta mixture into a small baking dish, spoon marinara with Italian sausage over the top. Top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake at 375°F for 25–30 min, until bubbly and golden around the edges.
Garnish with fresh basil. Serve with garlic bread slices.

name: Pizza Dip

ingredients.name: Italian Seasoning, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder
ingredients.text: Italian Seasoning, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder

instructions:
Add cream cheese, 1.5 cups mozzarella, seasonings, and half of the pepperoni to the Crockpot. Stir until combined.
Cook on low for 2-3 hours, stirring occasionally.
Top with remaining cheese and pepperoni. Cover and cook until the cheese is melted.

name: Ricotta Dip
instructions:
Beat ricotta + mascarpone together until very smooth.
Add powdered sugar, vanilla, orange zest, and a pinch of cinnamon.
Fold in mini chocolate chips,
Chill at least 1 hour until it thickens.
Serve with strawberries, vanilla wafers, or broken cannoli shells.

name: Tiramisu Dip
instructions:
Whip heavy cream to soft peaks.
In another bowl, beat mascarpone + cream cheese + sugar + espresso + vanilla.
Fold whipped cream into the espresso mixture.
Dust lightly with cocoa. Serve with strawberries and vanilla wafers.

name: BBQ Chicken Marinade
instructions:
Cube chicken and combine all ingredients for marinade. Let marinade overnight.
Airfry at 375 for 10-12 minutes, shaking halfway.
Add another 1-2 tablespoons of barbecue sauce.
Airfry for an additional 1-2 minutes.

name: Bone-in Beef Short Ribs
instructions:
Season ribs and coat in 3 tbsp flour, sear ribs with a high-heat oil.
Add ½ a sliced onion and 3 medium diced carrots to the pan, and sear off.
Stir in 1 tbsp of tomato paste, garlic, and Worcestershire. Deglaze pan with 1.5 cups dry red wine.
Simmer for 15 minutes, and allow the red wine to reduce.
Add ribs, sauce, and 1/2 cup beef broth to Crock Pot with herbs on top.
Cook on low for 6-8 hours.
Strain sauce, and serve with mashed potatoes.

name: Gigi Hadid Pasta
instructions:
Start cooking pasta in salted water. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water.
In a separate pan, saute 1 shallot and garlic with ⅓ cup olive oil. Cook until fragrant.
Add tomato paste, and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add 1 cup heavy cream and 2 teaspoons red pepper flakes, and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add in pasta, pasta water, and 2 tablespoons butter.
Add in parmesan cheese and seasonings.

name: Short Rib Pasta
instructions:
Pat short ribs dry. Season very generously with salt and pepper on all sides.
In a heavy Dutch oven, heat olive oil over medium-high until shimmering.
Sear ribs in batches (don’t crowd!) until browned on all sides, about 3–4 min per side.
Transfer ribs to a plate.
In the same pot, add onion, carrot, and celery; sauté 8–10 min until softened and golden. Stir in garlic, cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato paste; cook 2 minutes until darkened — this deepens the flavor.
Pour in red wine, scraping up browned bits with a wooden spoon. Let this reduce by half (5-7 minutes).
Stir in crushed tomatoes, beef broth, and the bouquet garni.
Return ribs (and any juices) to the pot. The liquid should almost cover the meat — add a splash more broth or water if needed.
Bring to a simmer, then cover and reduce heat to low (barely bubbling).
Braise 3–3½ hours, until the meat is fork-tender and falling apart.
To finish the sauce, remove ribs and herbs. Shred the meat with two forms and discard bones/herbs.
Return to the pot and combine with the rest of the sauce.
Let simmer uncovered for 20-40 minutes until desired thickness.
Combine with pasta and starchy pasta water. Serve with parmesan and basil.
